figurative_meaning_en: One who beats their own drum (self-praise or boasting)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সবসময় আত্মঘোষ করে, তার কোনো কাজের প্রশংসা অন্য কেউ করে না।
প্রতিযোগিতায় জিতে সে আত্মঘোষ শুরু করল।
example_sentences_in_english: He always engages in self-praise; no one else appreciates his work.
After winning the competition, he started blowing his own trumpet.
note: This idiom draws from the common Bengali expression of self-promotion akin to beating one's own drum, reflecting cultural aversion to overt boasting.
